text:
anita: FYI — firewall rollout scheduled 22:00 UTC will flip infra egress to default deny for 10.200.0.0/16. Concerned this will block KMS and prevent GPU nodes in usw2 from decrypting volumes on boot. Can we gate it?

ryan: which changeset is going live?

security-oncall: PR#5123 is the change. It converts the infra firewall to deny-by-default and only permits a short allowlist of operator IPs. No KMS or NAT EIP entries yet.

kevin: Reminder: GPU warm-pool and autoscale nodes use the regional KMS via our NAT GW to unwrap EBS. If egress to kms.us-west-2.amazonaws.com is blocked they fail at attach+decrypt and never register. Seen this once in staging — cloud-init loops on decrypt.

sre-ops-bot: ALERT: 2025-02-18T21:03:12Z — Observed 8 gpu nodes in cluster-usw2 with decrypt failures during recent test window. Log snippet: ```Feb 18 21:02:58 gpu-node-03 cloud-init[1456]: volume_decrypt: ERROR: AccessDeniedException: User not authorized to use KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01```

emma: We should avoid brittle IP allowlists for AWS-managed endpoints. Proposed quick mitigations: (A) add KMS VPC endpoint IDs (vpce-0a1b2c) to firewall allowlist, (B) exempt warm-pool subnets from deny, or (C) whitelist NAT GW Elastic IPs as fallback. Longterm: enable proxy FQDN allow for `kms.*.amazonaws.com`.

ryan: Does the firewall support FQDN rules today? IIRC it's CIDR-only.

security-oncall: Correct — current appliance is CIDR-only. Proxy FQDN solution requires coord with proxy team and config rollout and isn't ready for tonight. Fastest safe path: hotfix PR to add vpce-0a1b2c and NAT EIP 3.120.45.67 to the allowlist, or carve out the warm-pool subnets from the change.

anita: Plan: pause the rollout, open a hotfix PR that adds the VPC endpoint allow rules and NAT EIP as a fallback, and add a smoke test. I'll open PR#5130 and tag release.

kevin: Smoke test steps we should automate in the runbook: 1) from a pod scheduled in warm-pool subnet run `curl -vk https://kms.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/` expecting TLS 200/403 depending, 2) `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://test.blob` (with service role), 3) attempt to attach a small EBS volume encrypted with the infra key and verify `lsblk` shows decrypted device within 3m, 4) verify node registers to cluster. Add acceptance: "KMS unwrap + node join within 5m".

emma: I'll author runbook PR#789 with those steps and add a monitoring rule: `gpu.node.decrypt.failures > 0 for 5m` -> page oncall and trigger webhook to halt infra rollouts.

security-oncall: Holding tonight's rollout. Do not merge PR#5123 until one of: (1) vpce allowlist in place, (2) NAT EIP whitelisted, or (3) proxy FQDN rule confirmed. I'll post a comment on the PR and set the release flag to blocked.

ryan: Acknowledged. I've updated the release window to held and notified release-manager. Rollback/abort window at 22:15 UTC if any errors. :thumbsup:

anita: Thanks — applying hold and opening hotfix now. Will ping when PR#5130 is up.

kevin: Post-hotfix follow-up: add CI gate that boots a minimal gpu node in a sandbox and validates KMS unwrap; prevent future firewall PRs from merging without passing that gate.

anita: Agreed — created follow-ups and assigned owners. Will update this thread after the hotfix merges and smoke tests pass.

sre-ops-bot: NOTE: follow-ups created -> runbook PR#789, hotfix PR#5130, alert PR#5141.
